stem.text: A wire is extended by a force. The graph shows how the extension of the wire varies with the force applied.

stem.alt: Extension against force graph for a wire: a straight line through the origin O, with labelled points S, T, M, P, R and Q, axis marks d, 2d, W and 2W, and dashed guide lines.

stem.text: Initially a force $W$ gives an extension $d$. The force is then increased to $2W$. This increases the extension to $2d$.
Which area of the graph represents the work done by the force when the force increases from $W$ to $2W$?
